endpoints.permissions: Only GET/HEAD on the single-segment /media/:filename path bypass normal instance-token authentication, after the application authority fence. The handler requires the signed expires/signature pair; /api/media/*, other methods, and multi-segment paths do not inherit this exemption. Configured Origin policy and service readiness still apply. Anyone holding a valid complete link can read until expiry; owner is checked at issuance, not re-resolved from the unsigned reader. Supports one byte range, open-ended/suffix ranges, and private caching bounded by remaining TTL. The implementation also supplies HEAD with the same validation and no body; HEAD is not selected as another public catalog operation.
endpoints.resultDelivery: Full media bytes.
